rule: Eligible = E1 AND E2 AND E3 AND E4 AND E5 AND E6 (brief §31). Not a majority vote. Verdicts are per family, and the two families are NOT compared on effect size (brief §20).

E1_semantic_validity.what_the_endpoint_means: mean absolute lane deviation from the lane centre in metres, L(t)=|LN(t)|

evidence.channel_documentation: LN = 'Lane deviation from center line in meters.' (*_channels.tsv description, verbatim)
evidence.task_documentation: subjects were instructed to return the vehicle to the center of the lane (both READMEs, verbatim)
evidence.centre_identified: the release's own lane vocabulary fires where the vehicle is 'right of'/'left of' the defined lane of travel; every 4220 falls at LN>0 and every 4230 at LN<0

E1_semantic_validity.residual_caveat: the signing convention (which side is positive) is undocumented and is NOT needed: |LN| is sign-free. What the test establishes is that LN=0 is the lane centre, not which side is which.
E1_semantic_validity.open_scientific_question: the endpoint can in principle be driven far outside the lane: the T2 preflight recording reaches |LN| = 31.5 m with 24.7 % of time beyond the 0.917 m boundary, and contains the sample's only collision and its four near-misses. Whether 'mean |LN|' and 'hard safety failure' should be one target or two is a WHAT decision for the PI and is NOT resolved here.

evidence.quantisation: float32 with continuous steps; no integer lattice, so no quantisation floor to correct for
evidence.reconstruction_is_reproducible: the valid window is re-derived from the bytes in this lane and agrees with Phase 3B's `vehicle_effective_sampling.csv` pad values to floating point

evidence.source: Phase 3B `temporal_alignment.csv`, verdict FULL on all four recordings; Phase 3C re-derives the valid window and agrees

E3_temporal_linkage.note: Phase 3C does not use EEG, so E3 is about the *behavioural* series being locatable in time, which it is to the sample.

evidence.rule: pre-declared: a range of at least 0.05 m across 5-minute windows is required. Observed 0.21-0.24 m on the four Tier-1 recordings, i.e. 4-5x the threshold; the T2 preflight recording reaches 2.70 m, two orders of magnitude above it.
evidence.not_a_fatigue_claim: this establishes that the target varies within a person; it does not establish that it declines
evidence.scale_warning: the dynamic range is NOT homogeneous across participants: the T2 preflight recording's range is 11-13x the Tier-1 ranges, so a single pooled variance would be dominated by such participants. This is a property of the cohort, not a defect of the endpoint, and it is a reason the cohort-scale audit was requested rather than assumed.

evidence.condition_cycle_is_a_measurable_period: tile markers arrive at a median spacing of 38.5-40.2 s in every recording, and 6 blocks are separated by >90 s gaps that match the documented 6-block protocol

perturbation_rate_factor_not_recoverable.consequence: the 2x2 condition labels cannot be recovered behaviourally, so a condition-label model is NOT fitted; the observable cycle and the block are used instead

evidence.separability_argument: time-on-task contrast is expressible (T_session spans 0.7-1.2 h), the documented condition cycle is expressible (T_local within a ~40 s tile), and the block effect is expressible, so the brief's key diagnostic — naive vs condition-aware — is constructible rather than blocked

evidence.local_validation_sample: 2 participants x 1 baseline recording each (T1 64ch@2048 and T3 256ch@1024), which is what the endpoint reconstruction is demonstrated on
evidence.rule: pre-declared: >= 30 independent participants with usable Baseline vehicle data. This is a *metadata* count from the frozen index; the behavioural audit itself has NOT been run at cohort scale (see the access plan) — the count establishes that the cohort exists, not that the endpoint has been validated on it.

evidence.documented_detection_criterion: Course correction has been detected because the vehicle has a heading error of more than 5.1566 degrees from the forward direction or the driver is steering away from the perturbation with a steering angle of more than 4 degrees.
evidence.why_no_threshold_was_invented: the producer documents the criterion that generates 4311/4312, so RT is built from the delivered marker; no steering or derivative threshold, percentile or latency cutoff was chosen by this lane

E1_semantic_validity.residual_caveat: the criterion is a disjunction (heading error OR steering away) and heading error is not among the released channels, so the marker's internal branch cannot be recomputed from the signal

evidence.why_inconclusive: the marker forms two clusters across the three site classes, measured with an identical definition: T2 and T3 agree closely (median 1.4399 s vs 1.4189 s, neither has any RT above 5 s), while T1 is separated by 2.5x in median and 6-9x in IQR with 25.5% of responses above 5 s and a detectable left/right asymmetry the others do not show. Both use the same event codes and the same documented criterion, so this is either a site/protocol difference or a marker that does not measure the same thing everywhere. Nothing in the release, and nothing in these five recordings, decides which.
evidence.secondary_anomaly: T2's missed rate is 11.1% against 0.4-0.6% elsewhere; this recording contains 3200 gaps as short as 2.9 s, so overlapping episodes are a candidate mechanism. NOT verified here — recorded as the next check.
evidence.not_a_threshold_problem: this cannot be fixed by choosing a different threshold, because the marker is the producer's; the ambiguity is about what the marker means

evidence.pairing: every perturbation carries a sample index on the EEG clock; the response marker is on the same clock

evidence.site_label_is_inseparable_from_subject_h: the local sample is one participant per site class, so site and subject are perfectly confounded in Phase 3C
evidence.block_and_condition_effects: not yet evaluated for RT at window scale, because E2 is unresolved and a time-on-task model on a marker of unknown meaning would add no information
evidence.reason: E5 cannot be established while E2 is unresolved: separating a site effect from a block effect requires first knowing that the quantity being compared is the same quantity

evidence.n_perturbations_per_baseline_recording_m: the release's own sidecars carry hundreds of perturbations per baseline recording; Phase 3C verified 240-315 valid RTs in the two local baselines
evidence.consequence: a perturbation-RT endpoint is a Baseline-arm endpoint only: the Calibration recordings in this sample deliver perturbation onsets but zero course-correction markers, which is the first behavioural evidence that Calibration and Baseline are different task configurations

documentation.4411: Vehicle approached within 3 meters of obstacle resulting in near miss.
documentation.4421: Vehicle collided with an environmental entity.

safety_events_observed.interpretation: these are the only unambiguous objective functional failures present in the sample: a collision is a task failure by definition, not a continuous score. n=1 collision in one recording is not a rate estimate; it is an eligibility-relevant fact about whether the task can produce hard failure events at all

distance_to_goal_inputs.behavioural_audit_scale: 5 recordings / 3 participants after the T2 preflight (2 Tier-1 participants x 2 arms + 1 T2 baseline); cohort scale NOT executed (see behavior_data_access_plan.md)
